# The day's network plan

Owners: prospector (connection suggestions), linkedin-editor (comments and the post idea), messenger (people already
in a thread); the Recruiter runs it and brings the owner the plan. Tier: T1 (a plan and staged drafts); every request,
comment and post is T3: connects and follows with no note go out from the posts lane within the caps (charter,
once `pace.py` is committed); notes, comments and posts only after the owner's yes (`playbooks/send-after-yes.md`).
Today is !`date +%F`.

Principle: connect with people who make sense, not random people: people who can actually help reach a job. Comments
express the owner's own view on what the post says. Posts of the owner's own are rare.

Voice and style: follow the user's style config (`<data>/config/style.yaml`, keys `style.*`) and voice guide
(`<data>/profile/VOICE.md`) if present; these are filled in by the user, not shipped.

## Inputs
- `hub/NEXT-UP.md`, `state/daily/<date>-fresh10.md` and `state/daily/<date>-fresh10-people.md` (the daily fresh-roles rows
  and the named candidates for those without a warm path), `prospects/*.md`, `targets/people-watch.yaml`,
  `state/network/network-map.json` (the network map, when it exists), the X watch review files
  (`state/review/x-watch-<date>.md`) and the posts lane's `state/posts/sweep-<date>.jsonl` (posts read in the owner's
  Chrome: `url`, `author`, `text`).
- The owner's view per focus, every sentence cited, for comments and the post idea, gated first:
  `python3 scripts/answers_check.py profile/answers/<family>.md`. Exit 0: draw from that file. Exit 1: do not
  draw; the findings go to the Recruiter. Exit 2 (`missing:`): no bank for this family; say so in the plan.

## Outputs
- `state/network/<date>.md`: suggestions, live threads, NEXT-UP companies with nobody known, posts worth a comment,
  the post idea, the lint result.
- Staged drafts: `state/drafts/N-<date>/` (connection notes, LinkedIn comments) and `state/drafts/N-<date>-x/`
  (X replies). Nothing filed, nothing sent.

## Procedure
Work from the user's data folder.
1. **Build:** `python3 scripts/network_plan.py --today <date>` (`--dry-run` to preview). Read every row.
2. **Suggestions** (up to the plan's daily cap). Start with the daily rows that have no warm path: the people named in
   `state/daily/<date>-fresh10-people.md` (`python3 scripts/fresh10_people.py --net --write` when it is missing) are
   candidates, never prospects; verify each first (skill `research-person`: two independent sources), and only a
   verified person becomes a suggestion. Then the rest; each names why this person can help get a job (a hiring post, a
   team at a NEXT-UP company, the path to an open role, a referrer path, an alum). A row whose reason does not hold up:
   delete its staged draft and say why in the plan's reply. Connections go with no note; once accepted, messenger
   opens: a first touch opens a conversation about them (one specific, true thing they said or built and one real
   question about it), never a pitch: no resume line, no ask until there is rapport (outbox lint enforces the
   first-touch rules). Never in a cold note or comment: the owner's employment status unless asked, or internal
   employer numbers; the owner's policy config says what else is off limits. X follows carry no note:
   `python3 scripts/x_api.py follow --handle <h> --request`, only after X credits.
3. **Live threads:** no cold note. Hand each to messenger, who opens the thread and continues from the last message,
   verbatim.
4. **Nobody known at a NEXT-UP company:** the plan prints `people_traces.py --company <slug> --team agents`; the
   prospector runs it (it reads the web) and adds the people it verifies (skill `research-person`).
5. **Comments** (up to the plan's cap, linkedin-editor): only a post whose subject is the owner's work; the draft is the
   owner's view from `profile/answers`, never a job ask (outbox lint refuses phrases such as "hire me", "open to work",
   "DM me", "I'm looking", "please refer", "my resume"). Re-read the post in its source before filing; a post you cannot
   open is dropped.
6. **Post idea** (one a week): linkedin-editor drafts it with skill `linkedin-draft` from the record.
7. **File for approval** on the Recruiter's go: `python3 scripts/outbox.py lint --batch N-<date>` prints `{}`, then
   `python3 scripts/outbox.py create --batch N-<date>`; X replies: `python3 scripts/x_api.py reply ... --request`.
   The posts lane acts: connects within the caps; notes, comments and replies after the owner's yes, through
   `playbooks/send-after-yes.md` (`/linkedin-assist` when the owner prefers to send personally).
8. **Receipt and reply:** `network: <n> suggestions, <m> comments, post idea yes|no`; `NEEDS_OWNER` when approvals wait.

## Gate
`network_plan.py` exit 0; `outbox.py lint --batch N-<date>` prints `{}`; every suggestion row has a reason; no draft
holds a job ask or anything the style config or policy config forbids.

## Stop conditions
A draft that would only work for a stranger (no real reason); a post whose text cannot be re-read; the owner said to hold
outreach (record it and stop).

## Scope
Writes the plan and staged drafts only; the posts lane does the acting (step 7). Never edits prospects, targets or
`hub/NEXT-UP.md`.
